Here's the full schema with RL-relevant annotations:

## Action array (`"actions"`)
| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `-1` | Not observed / no-op (Recharge turn) |
| `0`–`3` | Use move (moves sorted alphabetically) |
| `4`–`8` | Switch to bench Pokémon (sorted alphabetically) |
| `9`–`12` | Tera + move (gen9 only, index `-9` gives move) |

---

## State keys (each timestep)

### Terminal flags
| Key | RL use |
|-----|--------|
| `battle_won` | +reward at final step |
| `battle_lost` | –reward at final step |
| `forced_switch` | Constrains legal actions to switches only (4–8) |

### Team state
| Key | RL use |
|-----|--------|
| `opponents_remaining` | How many opponent Pokémon still alive (1–6). Reward signal: this decrementing = KO |
| `player_conditions` | Side effects on your field (Stealth Rock, Spikes, Reflect, Light Screen, etc.) |
| `opponent_conditions` | Side effects on opponent's field |
| `weather` | Active weather (Sand, Rain, Sun, Hail, Snow) — affects damage, speed, healing |
| `battle_field` | Terrain / field effects (Electric Terrain, Psychic Terrain, etc.) |
| `player_prev_move` | What you did last turn — needed for Sleep/Freeze clause tracking |
| `opponent_prev_move` | What opponent did last turn |
| `can_tera` | Whether Tera is still available (gen9) |
| `opponent_teampreview` | Opponent's team species list (gen9, revealed at battle start) |
| `format` | Ruleset identifier (gen1ou, gen4uu, gen9ou, etc.) |

### Per-Pokémon (active + each bench slot)
| Key | RL use |
|-----|--------|
| `name` | Species — type matchups, role inference |
| `base_species` | Base form (for Megas, formes) |
| `hp_pct` | 0.0–1.0 — damage taken = reward signal |
| `status` | `par`/`slp`/`frz`/`brn`/`psn`/`fnt`/`nostatus` — speed drop, damage-over-time, sleep/freeze clause |
| `types` | Type chart interactions |
| `item` | Held item (Leftovers recovery, Choice lock, etc.) |
| `ability` | Ability effects |
| `base_*` | Base stats (HP, Atk, SpA, Def, SpD, Spe) — needed for damage calc |
| `*_boost` | Stat stage modifiers (-6 to +6) — Swords Dance, Intimidate, etc. |

### Per-Move (inside each Pokémon's `moves` array)
| Key | RL use |
|-----|--------|
| `name` | Move name |
| `move_type` | Type for STAB/effectiveness |
| `category` | Physical / Special / Status |
| `base_power` | Damage calc (0 for status moves) |
| `accuracy` | Hit probability (1.0 = always hits) |
| `priority` | Speed bracket override |
| `current_pp` / `max_pp` | PP remaining — running out forces Struggle |

---

**Most useful for reward shaping:** `hp_pct` deltas (damage dealt/taken), `opponents_remaining` decrements (KOs), `status` changes (sleep/paralysis inflicted), `battle_won`/`battle_lost` (terminal).

content.text:
For the active Pokémon's moves and bench Pokémon's known moves:

| Field | Meaning | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `base_power` | Raw damage power before modifiers (STAB, type effectiveness, stats). `0` = status move (does no direct damage). | Hyper Beam = 150, Thunder Wave = 0 |
| `category` | `"physical"` (uses Atk/Def), `"special"` (uses SpA/SpD), or `"status"` (no damage, applies effect). | Earthquake = physical, Psychic = special, Toxic = status |
| `accuracy` | Probability the move lands: `1.0` = always hits, `0.75` = 75% chance, `0.0` = never misses (Swift, etc.). | Fire Blast = 0.85, Thunder = 0.7 |
| `priority` | Speed bracket override. `0` = normal, `+1` goes before normal, `-6` goes after. | Quick Attack = +1, Whirlwind = -6 |
| `current_pp` | How many uses remain. At 0 the move cannot be selected. | Earthquake 8/16 means 8 uses left |
| `max_pp` | Total PP the move started with. `current_pp / max_pp` tells you how depleted it is. | 16 → 8 → 0 → Struggle |
